title: [Đề 08] Bộ Đề Thực Chiến B1 Số 04 — Chuẩn Đầu Ra ULIS (Clever Birds)
description: Đề luyện thi thực chiến VNU Test Bậc 3 chuẩn hóa theo khung năng lực ngoại ngữ Bậc 3 (CEFR B1). Bài đọc thực tế: Clever Birds (Part 2), Transport in London (Part 3), Cross-Country Skiing in Sweden (Part 4).

tasks.title: Part 1: Signs & Notices
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. Choose the best answer (A, B, or C) that matches the meaning of each sign, message, or notice.

questions.prompt:
COMPUTER GAMES SHOW
Buy two tickets and get the third one half price.
Hurry! Last few days of offer.
Only until the end of the week.

options.text: You can save money this week.
Tickets are only available this week.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo triển lãm trò chơi máy tính ghi: 'Buy two tickets and get the third one half price. Hurry! Last few days of offer. Only until the end of the week.' (Mua 2 vé được giảm nửa giá vé thứ ba. Nhanh lên! Những ngày cuối của chương trình ưu đãi. Chỉ đến hết tuần này). Điều này đồng nghĩa với việc bạn có thể tiết kiệm tiền trong tuần này ('You can save money this week'). Phương án A sai vì không giảm 30% cho mọi vé; C sai vì chỉ ưu đãi kết thúc tuần này chứ không phải vé chỉ bán trong tuần này. Đáp án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: chương trình khuyến mãi, ưu đãi

questions.prompt: We can only take you on the school trip if your parents have said it's OK. Please ask them to fill in the form.

options.text: Parents can come on the trip if they want.
Pupils must fill in a form and show it to their parents.
The school can take pupils on the trip if their parents let them go.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo của nhà trường nêu rõ: 'We can only take you on the school trip if your parents have said it's OK. Please ask them to fill in the form.' (Nhà trường chỉ có thể đưa các em đi dã ngoại nếu phụ huynh đồng ý. Vui lòng nhờ bố mẹ điền vào mẫu đơn). Câu này tương đương với 'The school can take pupils on the trip if their parents let them go'. Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: chuyến đi dã ngoại của trường

questions.prompt:
The school's sports hall is used by all pupils for gym and indoor sports. There is also an outdoor area for hockey and football.

This text is

options.text: describing the sports lessons at the school.
explaining where you can do sports at the school.
saying that the pupils at the school are good at sports.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn thông báo giới thiệu khu nhà đa năng ('sports hall') dùng cho thể dục và thể thao trong nhà, cùng khu vực ngoài trời ('outdoor area') dành cho khúc côn cầu và bóng đá. Do đó, văn bản này đang giải thích các địa điểm học sinh có thể tập thể thao ở trường ('explaining where you can do sports at the school'). Đáp án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: nhà thi đấu/tập luyện thể thao đa năng

questions.prompt:
Jim,
Any chance your mum could take me home in the car after school today? I forgot to bring the money for my bus ticket!
Mark

What does Mark want to do?
questions.explanationVi: Mark nhắn cho Jim: 'Any chance your mum could take me home in the car after school today? I forgot to bring the money for my bus ticket!' (Hôm nay tan học mẹ cậu có thể cho mình đi nhờ xe ô tô về nhà được không? Mình quên mang tiền mua vé xe buýt mất rồi!). Như vậy Mark muốn đi cùng xe với gia đình Jim về nhà ('travel home with Jim'). Đáp án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: liệu có khả năng/cơ hội nào (cách hỏi nhờ lịch sự)

questions.prompt:
How about joining the school singing group? It doesn't matter if you can't read music. All staff and pupils welcome! Mondays after lessons at 4 p.m.

Who can join the singing group?

options.text: people who can already read music

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo ghi rõ: 'It doesn't matter if you can't read music. All staff and pupils welcome!' (Không biết đọc nhạc cũng không sao. Chào đón tất cả cán bộ nhân viên và học sinh!). Điều này có nghĩa là bất kỳ ai ở trường ('anyone at the school') cũng đều có thể tham gia nhóm hát. Đáp án A đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: đội ngũ cán bộ, nhân viên, giáo viên

questions.prompt:
If you are not well and miss a class, please ask a classmate to tell you what was taught.

Who is this message for?

options.text: pupils who couldn't go to a lesson
pupils who would like to help their friends

questions.explanationVi: Lời nhắn viết: 'If you are not well and miss a class, please ask a classmate to tell you what was taught.' (Nếu em bị ốm và phải nghỉ một buổi học, vui lòng hỏi bạn cùng lớp để biết nội dung bài đã dạy). Thông báo này hướng dẫn những học sinh đã không thể tới dự tiết học do bị ốm ('pupils who couldn't go to a lesson'). Đáp án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: nghỉ học, bỏ lỡ một tiết học

questions.prompt:
RESERVED PARKING
For Bank Customers Only

options.text: People using the bank are allowed to park here.
Employees of the bank can park their cars here.
Nobody is allowed to park in front of the bank.

questions.explanationVi: Biển báo đỗ xe ghi: 'RESERVED PARKING - For Bank Customers Only' (Khu vực đỗ xe dành riêng - Chỉ dành cho khách hàng của ngân hàng). Điều này có nghĩa là những người đang giao dịch/sử dụng dịch vụ tại ngân hàng được phép đỗ xe tại đây ('People using the bank are allowed to park here'). Đáp án A đúng.

tasks.title: Part 2: Cloze Test
tasks.instructions: Read the text below and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each blank from 8 to 15.

passage.title: Clever Birds
passage.text:
The wild birds known as ravens are thought to be very clever. In fact, they can solve some quite (8) ________ problems, especially when they're trying to get food. For example, one bird was filmed taking a box of nuts from a bird table and (9) ________ it onto the ground, so that it would break and the bird could eat the nuts inside!

Scientists also (10) ________ that the birds could actually use stones as tools to (11) ________ out simple tasks. So in an experiment, they taught five birds to use a tool to open a box with food inside. The birds soon became very (12) ________ at doing this. So for the next experiment, the birds were given a small (13) ________ of tools to choose from. They always (14) ________ the tool that scientists had given them for the first task. And hours later, they could still (15) ________ which tool they'd used!

questions.prompt: In fact, they can solve some quite (8) ________ problems, especially when they're trying to get food.
questions.explanationVi: Cụm từ 'solve some quite complicated problems' (giải quyết một số vấn đề khá phức tạp). 'expert' là chuyên gia/thành thạo (chỉ người), 'heavy' là nặng về trọng lượng. Do đó 'complicated' phù hợp nhất về ngữ nghĩa. Đáp án B đúng.

questions.prompt: ...one bird was filmed taking a box of nuts from a bird table and (9) ________ it onto the ground...
questions.explanationVi: Động từ ngoại động từ 'drop something onto the ground' (thả rơi cái gì xuống mặt đất) để làm vỡ hộp hạt. 'fall' là nội động từ (tự rơi, không có tân ngữ 'it' theo sau), còn 'let' phải dùng 'let it fall'. Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: bàn đặt thức ăn cho chim ngoài trời

questions.prompt: Scientists also (10) ________ that the birds could actually use stones as tools...
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'notice that + mệnh đề' (nhận thấy, để ý thấy rằng loài chim này thực sự có thể dùng đá làm công cụ). 'advise' (khuyên bảo) và 'watch' (quan sát hành động đang diễn ra, không đi với 'that the birds could...') không phù hợp. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: ...use stones as tools to (11) ________ out simple tasks.
questions.explanationVi: Cụm động từ cố định (collocation): 'carry out a task / an experiment' (thực hiện, tiến hành một nhiệm vụ đơn giản). Đáp án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: thực hiện, tiến hành (nhiệm vụ, thí nghiệm)

questions.prompt: The birds soon became very (12) ________ at doing this.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc tính từ đi với giới từ 'at': 'become experienced at doing something' (trở nên thành thạo, có kinh nghiệm làm việc gì). 'intelligent' và 'correct' không kết hợp theo nghĩa 'trở nên thông minh/đúng đắn trong việc làm điều này'. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: So for the next experiment, the birds were given a small (13) ________ of tools to choose from.
questions.explanationVi: Cụm lượng từ đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều 'tools': 'a small number of tools' (một số lượng nhỏ các công cụ để lựa chọn). 'a total of' phải đi kèm con số cụ thể, 'a group of' thường dùng cho nhóm người/sinh vật hoặc vật xếp cụm. Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: một số lượng (đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều)

questions.prompt: They always (14) ________ the tool that scientists had given them for the first task.
questions.explanationVi: Động từ 'pick' có nghĩa là 'chọn lấy, nhặt lấy' ('picked the tool that scientists had given them' = luôn chọn đúng công cụ mà các nhà khoa học đã đưa cho ở nhiệm vụ đầu tiên). 'collect' là sưu tầm/thu gom nhiều thứ, 'look' phải có giới từ. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: And hours later, they could still (15) ________ which tool they'd used!
questions.explanationVi: Ngữ cảnh khen loài quạ thông minh: nhiều giờ sau, chúng vẫn có thể ghi nhớ ('remember') công cụ nào chúng đã sử dụng! 'remind' cần tân ngữ chỉ người ('remind somebody'), còn 'forget' (quên) trái ngược hoàn toàn với mạch văn. Đáp án B đúng.

tasks.title: Part 3: True / False
tasks.instructions: Read the text below and decide whether the statements from 16 to 20 are True or False. Choose A for True and B for False.

passage.title: Transport in London
passage.text:
TICKETS TO TRAVEL
Single fares are available for any journey, although visitors will find it easier and better value to purchase a Travelcard. Travelcards are valid for use on the Underground, bus, DLR, tram and national rail, and also offer a one-third discount on River services. They are available for one, three or seven days, and in peak or off-peak versions for one and three days.

CONGESTION CHARGE
If you are driving in central London between 7am and 6pm Mon-Fri (except public holidays), you need to pay the Congestion Charge. The charge is £8 per day, which must be paid in advance or on the day of travel. If you pay by midnight the next day, the charge is £10.

NATIONAL RAIL
Trains are useful for reaching places that are not served by the Tube. Mainline stations include: Waterloo and Victoria, serving the south of England; Paddington, the south-west; Euston, the north; King's Cross, the north-east; and Liverpool Street, the east.

UNDERGROUND
There are 12 colour-coded Tube lines. Most operate from 5am to 12.30am Mon-Sat, and from 7.30am to 11.30pm on Sundays. It's cheaper and less crowded to avoid the rush hour and travel after 9.30am. The network is divided into six concentric zones – zone 1 is the central area.

AIRLINES
Virgin Atlantic Airways links London with major cities in the USA and across the world. British Airways carries passengers between 175 domestic and international destinations. BMI, the UK's second largest airline, operates from Heathrow and offers low-cost domestic and European flights and flies to international destinations.

TO LONDON BY BUS
Green Line operates three coaches an hour to Baker Street, Marble Arch and Victoria. Fares from £11 single; journey time 75 mins. EasyBus runs every 40 mins to Baker Street. Fares from £2 single; journey time about 55 mins.

COACHES
A quick and inexpensive way of making a day trip out of London. Victoria Coach Station is a major hub for various bus companies.

DOCKLANDS LIGHT RAILWAY
The DLR connects the City and the Underground network with Docklands. It's also a useful link to Maritime Greenwich. Services operate from 5.30am to 12.30am and tickets must be purchased before boarding a train.

questions.prompt: Travelcard holders receive a 33% discount on London River Services.
questions.explanationVi: Trong mục TICKETS TO TRAVEL có ghi: 'Travelcards are valid for use on the Underground, bus, DLR, tram and national rail, and also offer a one-third discount on River services.' Giảm giá một phần ba ('a one-third discount') tương đương với giảm khoảng 33% trên dịch vụ tàu sông. Nhận định ĐÚNG (True - A).

questions.prompt: The Congestion Charge applies 07:00-18:00, Monday to Friday excluding public holidays.
questions.explanationVi: Trong mục CONGESTION CHARGE nêu rõ: 'If you are driving in central London between 7am and 6pm Mon-Fri (except public holidays), you need to pay the Congestion Charge.' Khung giờ 7am đến 6pm chính là 07:00–18:00 từ thứ Hai đến thứ Sáu trừ ngày nghỉ lễ ('except public holidays' = 'excluding public holidays'). Nhận định ĐÚNG (True - A).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: phí chống ùn tắc giao thông nội đô

questions.prompt: The Congestion Charge is £10 per day if you pay in advance.
questions.explanationVi: Trong mục CONGESTION CHARGE ghi: 'The charge is £8 per day, which must be paid in advance or on the day of travel. If you pay by midnight the next day, the charge is £10.' Nếu trả trước ('pay in advance') thì mức phí là 8 bảng/ngày, chỉ khi trả muộn vào ngày hôm sau mới là 10 bảng. Nhận định SAI (False - B).

questions.prompt: Trains are useful for reaching places that are not served by the metro system.
questions.explanationVi: Trong mục NATIONAL RAIL có câu: 'Trains are useful for reaching places that are not served by the Tube.' Hệ thống tàu điện ngầm ở London ('the Tube') chính là 'the metro system'. Do đó nhận định hoàn toàn khớp với bài đọc. Nhận định ĐÚNG (True - A).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: hệ thống tàu điện ngầm London
nhà ga đường sắt chính tuyến

questions.prompt: BMI is the largest airline in the United Kingdom.
questions.explanationVi: Trong mục AIRLINES ghi rõ: 'BMI, the UK's second largest airline, operates from Heathrow...' BMI chỉ là hãng hàng không lớn thứ hai ở Vương quốc Anh ('second largest airline') chứ không phải lớn nhất ('the largest'). Nhận định SAI (False - B).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: trung tâm đầu mối giao thông

tasks.title: Part 4: Reading Comprehension
tasks.instructions: Read the following passage and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each question from 21 to 25.

passage.title: Cross-Country Skiing in Sweden
passage.text:
by Jenna Walton, aged 15

Last year, Mum and I wanted to try a winter sport called cross-country skiing – travelling on skis across the countryside. And pictures of one area in Sweden, with people skiing along through forests on wonderful white snow, persuaded us that destination was a good choice. We hadn't done much skiing, though, so weren't sure how difficult cross-country skiing was, compared with skiing fast down steep mountains. But we signed up to join a group of people, of all ages, plus a guide.

We'd read about the place we went to before we left, so we knew it was close to where Sweden ends and Norway starts. And our family knew we couldn't text home, as there was no internet connection – and actually, it was relaxing to be far from anywhere, or anyone. What we hadn't realised was that from there, we'd be able to see amazing coloured lights in the sky, which appeared at certain times of year, called the Northern Lights – what a sight!

On our first day there, I hated getting up in the dark, but it meant I saw the sun come up over the forest, so I was glad I did. And sunshine was forecast for the week, I was delighted to hear! But the real problem was my 15kg rucksack, full of food and clothes – I had no idea it would weigh that much. Anyway, we skied for hours across mainly flat snow. Having special light skis was supposed to help us climb the few hills there were – although I still couldn't do it!

Finally we stopped for the night. It wasn't until we'd reached our hut that our guide mentioned we'd just crossed a frozen lake to get there – but nothing surprised us by that point! Anyway, he gave us all jobs to do – cutting fire wood and cooking food – and soon we were having dinner, made from whatever food we'd brought – a strange mix, but it tasted delicious. And everywhere was so peaceful outside that none of us stayed awake long.

Mum and I want to try another winter sports trip, maybe snowboarding. But we'll probably end up just as exhausted as we were after this trip!

questions.prompt: Jenna and her mum decided to go cross-country skiing in Sweden because

options.text: they wanted a change from mountain skiing holidays.
they'd heard the sport would be easier than skiing down hills.
they found a place there that they were keen to visit.

questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn 1, Jenna kể: 'And pictures of one area in Sweden, with people skiing along through forests on wonderful white snow, persuaded us that destination was a good choice.' Những bức ảnh về một vùng ở Thụy Điển đã thuyết phục hai mẹ con rằng điểm đến đó là lựa chọn tuyệt vời ('found a place there that they were keen to visit'). A và B sai vì bài nói họ chưa từng trượt tuyết nhiều và không chắc môn này khó hay dễ hơn trượt tuyết đổ đèo. Đáp án C đúng.

questions.prompt: After their arrival, what did they discover about where they were staying?

options.text: It wasn't far from the border with another country.
They could get great views of a spectacular natural event.
It was at a point where they couldn't use technology.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 chỉ rõ họ đã biết trước ('before we left') việc nơi đó gần biên giới Na Uy và không có kết nối internet. Điều họ chỉ mới phát hiện ra sau khi tới nơi là: 'What we hadn't realised was that from there, we'd be able to see amazing coloured lights in the sky... called the Northern Lights – what a sight!' (Họ có thể chiêm ngưỡng hiện tượng cực quang kỳ vĩ trên bầu trời = 'great views of a spectacular natural event'). Đáp án B đúng.

questions.prompt: How did Jenna feel about the long trips through the snow on skis?

options.text: surprised she had to carry such a heavy bag
pleased about the weight of the skis she was given
glad that going uphill wasn't as hard as she'd thought

questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn 3, Jenna chia sẻ: 'But the real problem was my 15kg rucksack, full of food and clothes – I had no idea it would weigh that much.' Cụm 'I had no idea it would weigh that much' cho thấy cô rất bất ngờ khi phải mang chiếc ba lô nặng tới 15kg ('surprised she had to carry such a heavy bag'). B và C sai vì dù có ván trượt nhẹ cô vẫn không leo dốc được ('although I still couldn't do it!'). Đáp án A đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: ba lô đi đường dài / leo núi

questions.prompt: Regarding their accommodation, Jenna says everyone

options.text: had difficulties getting to sleep there.
was unhappy at the quality of the food.
had to help out with all the housework.

questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn 4, khi tới căn lều nghỉ đêm ('hut'), người hướng dẫn đã giao việc cho tất cả mọi người: 'Anyway, he gave us all jobs to do – cutting fire wood and cooking food' (chẻ củi và nấu ăn = 'help out with all the housework'). A sai vì không ai thức lâu ('none of us stayed awake long'), B sai vì đồ ăn rất ngon ('tasted delicious'). Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: căn lều gỗ, chòi nghỉ chân
phụ giúp, chia sẻ công việc

questions.prompt: What would Jenna text to a friend about her trip?

options.text: One reason we chose this trip was that we thought we'd be among loads of trees, which we love – but that hasn't happened so far.
The people in our group were really friendly – but they were all Mum's age and older, really.
I'm not used to getting out of bed so early to do things! But it was worth it, as the sunrise was wonderful.

questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn 3, Jenna viết: 'On our first day there, I hated getting up in the dark, but it meant I saw the sun come up over the forest, so I was glad I did.' Điều này hoàn toàn khớp với tin nhắn C: không quen dậy sớm nhưng rất xứng đáng vì cảnh bình minh trên rừng tuyệt đẹp. A sai vì họ thực sự trượt qua rừng, B sai vì nhóm có đủ mọi lứa tuổi ('of all ages'). Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: cảnh mặt trời mọc, bình minh

tasks.title: Part 1: Short Recordings
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. For each question, you will listen to one short recording TWICE. Choose the right answer (A, B, or C).
tasks.transcript:
[Recording 1]:
Jack: Mum, I'm ringing to tell you I'm at Tim's house. Football practice finished early, so we walked here together.
Mum: OK. Well, it's half past five now, so I'll come in the car and pick you up. It'll take me about half an hour, so I'll see you at six.
Jack: Oh, there's something good on television then. Can you come and get me after it, at seven?
Mum: I can't, Jack, I've got to pick your dad up from the station then.

[Recording 2]:
Girl: We mustn't forget to send Mum a postcard ... how about this one with a picture of the mountain?
Boy: Well, it's nice but we can't actually see it from where we're staying. What about a view of the lake and the village instead? Or perhaps one of the garden pictures if you think she'd prefer it. Look at the cottage and all the flowers ...
Girl: Mmm ... I think your first idea was better ... we could put a cross to show where we're staying.
Boy: Right then, let's do that.

[Recording 3]:
Mum: Look, Kate, there are some of those biscuits you like!
Kate: Oh, yes. Mm ... there aren't many in a packet though, Mum. Why don't we have this cake instead? Remember I've got my friends coming tomorrow.
Mum: Oh, I haven't forgotten. I've already made a cake, and I've bought lots of ice cream.
Kate: Well, I suppose some biscuits would be nice with ice cream. Do we need anything else ...?

[Recording 4]:
Boy: Finish your drink – we'll be late for class. What are you looking for now? Don't tell me you've forgotten your homework. You said you were working on it really late.
Girl: Don't worry, it was the first thing I put in my bag – look, here it is. I won't be a second ... just checking everything. Pencil case, now where did I ....? Oh ... you'll be able to lend me a pen, won't you? Phone? Oh, here it is, in my pocket as usual ...

[Recording 5]:
Dad: Jamie, could you do something for me?
Jamie: Well, it depends what it is. I'm meeting my mates in town.
Dad: I want to clean the upstairs windows this afternoon, but I lent the ladder to John ... Could you come next door with me and help me carry it back? I'll give you a lift into town afterwards if you like.
Jamie: Sure, Dad.

[Recording 6]:
Woman: Because of the football finishing late, there are some changes to this evening's programmes. We won't now show the Nature Programme, about the sharks found in the Pacific, at nine o'clock. Instead, the cartoon film The Mighty Heroes will be at this time, an hour later than advertised. You can see the Nature Programme at its usual time next week.

[Recording 7]:
Boy: I'm off now, Mum. I'm going to meet Ben at the youth club because he's bought a new wheel for his bike and he wants me to help him put it on ... and I've got to go to the library to take my books back sometime today too.
Mum: Well, do that before you start work on the bike because it isn't open this afternoon.
Boy: OK. And we're going to play table tennis after we've done the bike, so I won't see you until supper this evening. Bye!

questions.prompt: When will Jack's mum pick him up?
questions.transcript:
Jack: Mum, I'm ringing to tell you I'm at Tim's house. Football practice finished early, so we walked here together.
Mum: OK. Well, it's half past five now, so I'll come in the car and pick you up. It'll take me about half an hour, so I'll see you at six.
Jack: Oh, there's something good on television then. Can you come and get me after it, at seven?
Mum: I can't, Jack, I've got to pick your dad up from the station then.
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn hội thoại, mẹ của Jack nói: 'Well, it's half past five now, so I'll come in the car and pick you up. It'll take me about half an hour, so I'll see you at six.' Jack xin lùi sang 7 giờ để xem TV nhưng mẹ từ chối vì lúc 7 giờ mẹ phải đón bố ở nhà ga. Vì vậy mẹ sẽ đón Jack lúc 6:00 (B).

questions.prompt: Which postcard will they send?

options.text: A view of the lake and the village
A cottage with a garden full of flowers
A picture of a high mountain

questions.transcript:
Girl: We mustn't forget to send Mum a postcard ... how about this one with a picture of the mountain?
Boy: Well, it's nice but we can't actually see it from where we're staying. What about a view of the lake and the village instead? Or perhaps one of the garden pictures if you think she'd prefer it. Look at the cottage and all the flowers ...
Girl: Mmm ... I think your first idea was better ... we could put a cross to show where we're staying.
Boy: Right then, let's do that.
questions.explanationVi: Cô gái đề xuất tấm bưu thiếp hình ngọn núi nhưng cậu bé thấy không hợp vì từ chỗ ở không nhìn thấy núi. Cậu bé đưa ra ý tưởng đầu tiên là cảnh hồ nước và ngôi làng ('What about a view of the lake and the village instead?'), sau đó nhắc thêm bức hình ngôi nhà nhỏ với vườn hoa. Cô gái kết luận: 'I think your first idea was better ... we could put a cross to show where we're staying.' Ý tưởng đầu tiên của cậu bé chính là cảnh hồ và ngôi làng (A).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: ngôi nhà nhỏ ở miền quê

questions.prompt: What do they decide to buy?
questions.transcript:
Mum: Look, Kate, there are some of those biscuits you like!
Kate: Oh, yes. Mm ... there aren't many in a packet though, Mum. Why don't we have this cake instead? Remember I've got my friends coming tomorrow.
Mum: Oh, I haven't forgotten. I've already made a cake, and I've bought lots of ice cream.
Kate: Well, I suppose some biscuits would be nice with ice cream. Do we need anything else ...?
questions.explanationVi: Mẹ chỉ cho Kate thấy những gói bánh quy cô bé thích. Kate định mua bánh ngọt (cake), nhưng mẹ nói đã tự làm bánh ngọt ở nhà và cũng đã mua rất nhiều kem (ice cream) rồi. Do đó Kate quyết định: 'Well, I suppose some biscuits would be nice with ice cream.' Hai mẹ con quyết định mua bánh quy (A).

questions.prompt: What has the girl forgotten to bring?
questions.transcript:
Boy: Finish your drink – we'll be late for class. What are you looking for now? Don't tell me you've forgotten your homework. You said you were working on it really late.
Girl: Don't worry, it was the first thing I put in my bag – look, here it is. I won't be a second ... just checking everything. Pencil case, now where did I ....? Oh ... you'll be able to lend me a pen, won't you? Phone? Oh, here it is, in my pocket as usual ...
questions.explanationVi: Cô gái kiểm tra cặp sách: bài tập về nhà ('homework') đã cho vào cặp đầu tiên, điện thoại ('phone') vẫn ở trong túi áo như thường lệ, nhưng khi tìm hộp bút thì cô thốt lên: 'Pencil case, now where did I ....? Oh ... you'll be able to lend me a pen, won't you?' Như vậy cô gái đã quên mang hộp bút/bút viết (B).

questions.prompt: How does the man want his son to help him?

options.text: Help carry a ladder back from next door

questions.transcript:
Dad: Jamie, could you do something for me?
Jamie: Well, it depends what it is. I'm meeting my mates in town.
Dad: I want to clean the upstairs windows this afternoon, but I lent the ladder to John ... Could you come next door with me and help me carry it back? I'll give you a lift into town afterwards if you like.
Jamie: Sure, Dad.
questions.explanationVi: Người bố nói với Jamie: 'I want to clean the upstairs windows this afternoon, but I lent the ladder to John ... Could you come next door with me and help me carry it back?' Bố muốn tự lau cửa sổ tầng trên nhưng cần con trai sang nhà hàng xóm khiêng giúp chiếc thang về (C).

questions.prompt: Which TV programme is on at nine o'clock tonight?

options.text: A cartoon film called The Mighty Heroes

questions.transcript: Woman: Because of the football finishing late, there are some changes to this evening's programmes. We won't now show the Nature Programme, about the sharks found in the Pacific, at nine o'clock. Instead, the cartoon film The Mighty Heroes will be at this time, an hour later than advertised. You can see the Nature Programme at its usual time next week.
questions.explanationVi: Phát thanh viên thông báo do trận bóng đá kết thúc muộn nên chương trình Thế giới Tự nhiên về cá mập sẽ không chiếu lúc 9 giờ tối nay nữa mà dời sang tuần sau. Thay vào đó: 'Instead, the cartoon film The Mighty Heroes will be at this time'. Vậy chương trình phát sóng lúc 9 giờ tối nay là phim hoạt hình (C).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: quảng cáo, thông báo lịch chiếu
chương trình khám phá thiên nhiên

questions.prompt: What will the boy do first?

options.text: Return his books to the library
Help Ben put a new wheel on his bike
Play table tennis at the youth club

questions.transcript:

Cậu bé đồng ý ('OK') và nói sẽ chơi bóng bàn sau khi sửa xe xong. Vậy việc đầu tiên cậu làm là đi trả sách ở thư viện (A).

tasks.title: Part 2: Short Conversations
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. For each question, you will listen to one conversation TWICE. Choose the right answer (A, B, or C).
tasks.transcript:
[Conversation 8]:
Boy: Hi, Angela. Waiting for the bus again? It's just as quick to walk into town from here, you know.
Girl: I know it's strange, especially as it takes 15 minutes to walk here from home, but I work in a shop in town on Saturdays with a friend. She lives further out of town, so she gets the bus in. It's a bit more sociable if we go together.
Boy: But how do you know which one she'll be on?
Girl: The buses come every 10 minutes on weekdays, but only once an hour on Saturdays, so I know exactly which one to get!

[Conversation 9]:
Boy: Have you seen the video for Lionheart's new song yet?
Girl: Yes, I watched it last night. It's really not like their other stuff, but I couldn't stop listening to it.
Boy: Maybe I'll start to like it once I've heard it a few more times. I don't think I've ever seen such an incredible video, though.
Girl: I think they hired a Hollywood director to make it - you can tell because of the quality.
Boy: The dancing looked like something from another planet!
Girl: I thought it was the costumes that created that effect. The routines themselves were quite like other videos I've seen.

[Conversation 10]:
Girl: My parents say I can get a new phone for my birthday.
Boy: Hey, that's great. So which model are you going to choose? Reading what phone buyers have written about their phones is probably more reliable than listening to a sales assistant telling you which one is best. I've heard that some phone companies give stores money for selling more of their phones, especially the newer, more expensive ones, so I'm not sure you could trust what they'd say.
Girl: That's useful to know. I'll ask my parents what they think is the best way to choose, too.
Boy: Good idea.

[Conversation 11]:
Boy: You don't usually look so happy at the end of a school day.
Girl: That's because we've usually been given a load of maths problems to do for the next day. Not today, though.
Boy: But you're good at maths - you usually get high marks.
Girl: I know, but it still takes time. Anyway, you know I finished that physics project last week?
Boy: Yeah ...
Girl: Well, the teacher was so impressed with it, she gave me a book.
Boy: Wow, that's great. Next thing you know, they'll make you captain of the football team.
Girl: That'd be unbelievable, but fairly unlikely as I hardly ever play football.

[Conversation 12]:
Girl: How was the weekend away?
Boy: Good, thanks. I had a really nice time with my cousins - we get on really well, and I always miss them for a few days after we come home. My aunt and uncle love having us there too, although he got a bit angry when my brother broke one of their vases.
Girl: Oh, dear!
Boy: Fortunately, it wasn't an old one, but I've never heard my uncle shout like that before. Visiting them for only a weekend's a bit cruel in a way. It feels like you've only just arrived and suddenly it's time to go.

[Conversation 13]:
Boy: Have you tried the new pool? It's awesome.
Girl: I went with my family last week. I had a few goes on those tubes with the water in - you know, the ones you can go down really fast and end up in the pool.
Boy: Oh yes, that was amazing.
Girl: I think I'd go back just to play on them. Lots of teenagers used the old pool too, but only because they didn't have anywhere else to go. The water in this new one is nowhere near as warm, but it's better in a way because it keeps you moving.
Boy: True.

tasks.title: Part 3: Extended Conversation (True / False)
tasks.instructions: You will hear a conversation between a boy called Lucas and a girl called Claire who have just been to a concert by a band called Candy Floss. Listen TWICE and decide if each sentence from 15 to 20 is Correct (True) or Incorrect (False). Choose A for True and B for False.
tasks.transcript:
Lucas: I'm really glad my mum let me go to the concert – I didn't think she would. But there were lots of people our age! What did you think of it, Claire?
Claire: Well, I wasn't sure at first if I could go, but luckily Mum and Dad bought me the ticket for my birthday and wasn't it great? Our seats were only ten rows from the front! We got a great view!
Lucas: Well, I was worried about the concert when I saw Candy Floss on TV last month – one band member had just left and they weren't brilliant. But I don't think they've ever performed as well as they did tonight.
Claire: Mmm – and what about their dancing? I thought they needed to do some more work on it when I saw them on TV during the summer, but tonight it was exciting!
Lucas: You notice that because you go to dance classes! I wasn't paying attention – probably too busy looking at their clothes! The dresses they had on in the first half were OK, I suppose, but what were those silver things they changed into after that?
Claire: Oh, they always wear those during their concerts – I think they looked really original.
Lucas: Really awful, you mean! Anyway, what about getting their new album? I'm not sure I can afford it now ...
Claire: There've been lots of reviews on the Internet, and some said it isn't very good, but the songs they did in the concert were great – and I've got all their other albums, so it'll add to my collection.
Lucas: You should, then.
Claire: Mmm – but did I tell you I've read the main singer's thinking of leaving?
Lucas: Well, if the fans think someone's leaving the band, they might not buy tickets for the next concert – that means plenty left for us to buy! I'd like to see the band again, wouldn't you?
Claire: Absolutely!

questions.prompt: Claire could see the band clearly from where she sat.
questions.transcript: Claire: Well, I wasn't sure at first if I could go, but luckily Mum and Dad bought me the ticket for my birthday and wasn't it great? Our seats were only ten rows from the front! We got a great view!
questions.explanationVi: Claire nói: 'Our seats were only ten rows from the front! We got a great view!' Chỗ ngồi của cô chỉ cách sân khấu 10 hàng ghế và có tầm nhìn rất rõ. Nhận định ĐÚNG (Correct - A).

questions.explanationVi: Lucas nhận xét: 'But I don't think they've ever performed as well as they did tonight.' Cậu cho rằng ban nhạc Candy Floss chưa bao giờ biểu diễn xuất sắc như tối nay. Nhận định ĐÚNG (Correct - A).

questions.prompt: Claire feels the band's dancing was better in the summer.

questions.explanationVi: Claire nói: 'I thought they needed to do some more work on it when I saw them on TV during the summer, but tonight it was exciting!' Hồi mùa hè cô thấy họ cần phải tập luyện thêm, còn tối nay mới thực sự sôi động. Do đó nói vũ đạo mùa hè tốt hơn là SAI (Incorrect - B).

dataCard.Date & Time: Thursday, May 5th, from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph about the advantages of studying abroad for university students.
guidelines: Improving foreign language skills through daily communication
Experiencing new cultures and becoming more independent
Gaining better career opportunities after graduation

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: The benefits of using public transport in big cities are numerous. First of all, taking buses and trains helps reduce traffic congestion and air pollution. One public bus can carry fifty passengers, which means fewer private cars and motorbikes are on the road during rush hours. For example, in cities with modern metro lines, the streets are cleaner and people can travel much faster. Secondly, using public transport is a great way for citizens to save money. Commuters only need to buy a cheap monthly ticket instead of paying a lot of money for fuel and parking fees every day. In summary, public transport is a smart choice that makes city life better.

cueCards.title: Describe your favourite type of weather.
prompts: what the type of weather is
how often you experience this type of weather
what you like doing in this weather
And explain why it is your favourite type of weather.
furtherQuestions: What's the weather like where you live?
Do you get in the habit of checking the weather forecast?
cueCards.sampleResponse: My favourite type of weather is cool and sunny autumn weather. In Hanoi, where I live, we usually experience this pleasant weather in October and November. On these days, the sky is clear blue and there is a gentle breeze. I love going for a walk around Hoan Kiem Lake with my friends, taking photos of yellow leaves, and drinking hot coffee at a street café. It is my favourite weather because it is neither too hot nor too cold, so I always feel energetic and comfortable when I go outside.

cueCards.title: Describe a job you have now or had in the past.
prompts: And describe how well you do or did the job.
furtherQuestions: In your opinion, do people work more now than in the past?
Do you think working from home is a good idea?
cueCards.sampleResponse: I would like to talk about my part-time job as an English tutor, which I got last year through a recommendation from my university classmate. My job involves teaching basic English grammar and vocabulary to two secondary school students twice a week. I wanted this job because I enjoy working with children and I wanted to earn some extra money for my books. I think I do this job quite well because my students enjoy our lessons and their school test scores have improved a lot this semester.
